profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 6+ years of experience building scalable web apps and delivering clean, maintainable code with intuitive user experiences

https://github.com/megelismi

positions.title: Full-time parenting
positions.description: Focused on raising my young children while maintaining technical skills through self-study and personal projects

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led development of full-stack features enabling secure order processing and seamless communication among patients, doctors, and pharmacies, impacting thousands of users daily
• Authored technical specifications and guided cross-team discussions to align engineering solutions with product roadmaps
• Mentored junior developers, improving code review efficiency and onboarding speed
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Software Architecture · React · Node.js · MySQL

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: •  Built a real estate CRM interface with instant alerts, auto-responses, call functionality, and user activity logging, improving agent response time

positions.title: 5th/6th Grade STEM Teacher
positions.description:
•  Taught ~75 students core concepts in robotics, electronics, and design thinking, fostering early STEM engagement
•  Managed makerspace projects that familiarized students with circuit design, product and game design, and micro controllers
• Collaborated with teachers and administrators to create a warm and demanding school culture that leads to high student achievement and behavioral growth

positions.title: 3rd/4th Grade Science Teacher
positions.description:
• Planned and taught 3rd and 4th grade science lessons that led to mastery of the New Generation Science Standards
• Managed an after school coding club that relays the basics of block coding to students ranging from 2nd-4th grade
• Led an intervention group that guided students to reading mastery of grade level material

positions.title: 3rd Grade Teacher
positions.description:
• Created effective and rigorous lesson plans that led to student mastery of state and Common Core Standards
• Increased the math Quality of Distribution Index 22% in the 2012-2103 school year
• Led students to achieving 25% growth in math during a 9 week period in the 2013-2014 school year

positions.title: Corps Member
positions.description:
• Engaged in extensive professional development focused on the growth mindset and effective teaching strategies
• Collaborated with fellow school team members around creative and engaging ways to teach state standards
• Led an after school program focused on math enrichment through project based learning for grades 3-6

positions.title: Website Manager
positions.description:
• Coded features of the magazine’s website using HTML	
• Organized and wrote a daily newsletter sent out to 10K subscribers
• Edited all written content for the magazine
• Corresponded with local media outlets to aggregate news for the website 
• Coordinated with the company’s owner to raise advertising profits by 30%

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
• Edited content for both print and online magazine articles
• Collaborated with another intern to design and create a UC Santa Barbara traditions page for the magazine’s website
